lines.text: You've a mark on you. I don't ask why. But the Wardens will, and they ask with the safety off.
You've chosen the people who break into my vats for the templates. I'll treat you anyway. That's the job.
There's a settled record from down there. I'll read it. I won't call it a diagnosis.
The canister has a Site Zero stamp. I recognise the template. That is my identification, not proof of where the voice comes from.
Okafor returns quietly in your record. She says she asks about the dreams. What she keeps private is hers to keep.
No origin appears in the lineage index you copied. That is a gap in a record. It is not a diagnosis.
Four willing templates reach the clinic in your record. Their recall tags enter its register. Care and registration both have consequences.
Open your eyes slowly. The light's cheap and it stays on. I'm Vantongeren. I was decanted here too.
Your lease still runs. You'll find the elapsed days on your record. Grade five earns an early discharge. Time does not earn a grade.
Still here. Good. Most aren't, and I don't say that to be cruel.

barks.text: The vats hum a quarter-tone flat when the Blacksite breathes. Nobody else hears it. You'll find you do.
